title: Create ++
body:
# Create++

Create++ is a carefully curated Minecraft modpack built around automation, engineering and large-scale factory building.

The pack expands the Create experience with quality-of-life improvements, exploration content and additional mechanical systems while keeping the gameplay balanced and intuitive. Whether you enjoy designing massive production lines, building realistic industrial complexes or optimizing resource processing, Create++ provides a polished experience focused on creativity and engineering.

Features:

* Expanded Create-based automation
* Improved progression and balance
* Additional building and decoration options
* Performance-friendly configuration
* Multiplayer support
* Carefully selected compatible mods

Build bigger. Automate smarter. Create more.
